description: GFlow fine-tuning protocol for the exp2 tuned yambda_50m TIGER checkpoint (loss = L_SFT + lambda * L_GFlow). shared_with_sft_control mirrors finetune_sft_only.json so the two arms are directly comparable; the consumer script loads THIS file as its argparse defaults, and tests/test_finetune_protocol_configs.py asserts both stay in sync.

known_deviations_from_sft_control.loss: L_SFT + lambda * L_GFlow with lambda from one-time gradient-norm calibration (control: L_SFT only)
known_deviations_from_sft_control.train_subset: fine-tunes on the last 8 train examples per user (69,495 examples) instead of the control's full last-128 layout (993,926) — the dense full-catalog reward caches would be ~224 GB per combo otherwise. The datamodule keeps the full layout so the catalog matches the checkpoint.
known_deviations_from_sft_control.batch_scaling: for large negative counts the micro-batch shrinks so batch*(K+1) <= max_candidate_batch, with grad accumulation keeping the effective batch at 2048

protocol_history.runs_before_2026-08-27: used validate_every=1, max_grad_norm=1.0, amp_dtype=bfloat16 (each run's resolved_config.json records its actual values); aligned to the SFT control when this file became the defaults source
